rows.grounds: vocative/name of goddess Tārā; mantra context in token 1 (L1/L2 passage)

rows.surface: oṃ hrīṃ yogini yogeśvari yogeśvari yoge bhayaṃkari sakalasthāvajaṅgamasya mukhaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama vaśyamākarṣayākarṣaya svāhā ||
rows.grounds: mantra formula invoking yoginī/yogeśvarī; includes bījas oṃ hrīṃ and closing svāhā; sakalasthāvarajaṅgamasya mukhaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama vaśyam ākarṣaya ākarṣaya = attract face and heart of all moving and unmoving beings to me (L1/L2 passage)
bīja/seed-syllable, transliterated only per Śrīvidyā ledger (L1/L2 passage)
name/epithet of the deity addressed in the mantra (L1/L2 passage)
indeclinable adverb dvaidhā/dvedhā indicating twofold manner (L1/L2 passage)
optative of √vad, prescribing utterance/recitation of the mantra (L1/L2 passage)
